text_block_list.text:
—Arriving at the Japan Cup venue. Right at 
the entrance of the racecourse, two 
Umamusume bumped into each other.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Top Road-san.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Ayabe-san. It's been a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And so—we will arrive at the venue 
separately.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes. I feel like I've gone back in time.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What kind of training have you been doing?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I won't say it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Doesn't it feel kind of lonely? 
Keeping it a secret to that extent, I 
mean.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I can't say I'm not lonely. But—I won't 
say it aloud.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training... have you been 
doing?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Then I won't tell you either. It's a 
secret.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

The two entered separate waiting rooms 
before heading out to the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, Doto-chan! I'm looking 
forward to today!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yeees, the pleasure is mine~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Let's take on the world's Umamusume and 
decide who is number one.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but everyone, listen. It's true that 
today is the battle to determine the best 
of our generation, but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to remember. A race isn't 
about only the single winner shining."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's only meaningful if 
you defeat someone worthy.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For example, if someone stumbles on stage 
and it ends up making the lead stand out 
more, that hardly counts as meaningful, 
does it?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Everyone should give a great performance, 
and whichever of them performed best ought 
to be the victor.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, that's true. What all the fans are 
looking for is—"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I think it's a showdown with real 
substance. Otherwise, the race wouldn't be 
exciting, after all.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. And the ones who put on those 
legendary races were the Umamusume of the 
generation above us. In other words...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "The Golden Generation."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Though they are called a single 
generation, each and every one of these 
Umamusume shines with a fierce, unique 
brilliance of her own."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because every single one 
of them clashes with all their might that 
they are praised, applauded, and called 
golden.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, that radiance isn't something 
only they can reach.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, the Rheingold is within our grasp as 
well! Let us show our own brilliance here, 
one that pales in comparison to no one."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Opera O-san...! Y-Yesss...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't need you to tell me that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A brilliance that rivals the Golden 
Generation...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I will prove it! And with that, let 
us all compete fair and square to see who 
wins!

"—The Golden Generation. A realm normally 
entirely out of reach, these four, having 
overcome various hardships, are finally 
reaching it."

"A miracle made possible because none were 
missing. Aiming to be standard-bearers of 
their generation—now, the four surge 
forward."
